entries.name: Strike
entries.description: A measured blow.

entries.name: Off-hand Jab
entries.description: Melee jab with the off-hand weapon (or bare hands) at distance 1: ranged units' point-blank answer.

entries.name: Shield Bash
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}.

entries.name: Hamstring
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Root for {rounds}.

entries.name: Shockwave
entries.description: Hits the 3 tiles in a line from you (aim at an adjacent tile). Friendly fire!

entries.name: Volley
entries.description: {name}: {power} power. Plus area, hits allies too. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Firebomb
entries.description: {name}: {power} power. Burst area, hits allies too. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. Hits a 3x3 area around a tile {reach:n} away.

entries.name: Guard
entries.description: Raise a light guard: -{mitigation} damage.

entries.name: Focus
entries.description: {name}: +50% attack for {rounds}.

entries.name: Move
entries.description: {name} up to 2 blocks (speed-based tiles per block), once per round: 1 AP per tile. Keeps your stance.

entries.name: Switch Target
entries.description: Lock onto a different enemy (no AP). Added automatically when an attack changes target.

entries.name: Staggered
entries.description: Block lost to Stagger.

entries.name: Stunned
entries.description: Block lost to Stun.

entries.name: Rest
entries.description: Catch your breath: recover {recover} and return to Neutral stance, free.

entries.name: Sunder
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. Armor-breaking chop.

entries.name: Reckless Swing
entries.description: All-in swing: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Aimed Shot
entries.description: {name}: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. A patient shot.

entries.name: Pinning Shot
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Root for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Arcane Bolt
entries.description: {name}: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. A bolt of raw force.

entries.name: Hex
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Haymaker
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stun for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Body Blow
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Quick Stab
entries.description: {name}: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. A fast thrust.

entries.name: Mend
entries.description: {name}: heals {heal}. A friendly unit within 3 tiles, or yourself.

entries.name: Rally
entries.description: {name}: grants haste for {rounds} starting next round. +1 tile per move block.

entries.name: Taunt Shout
entries.description: {name}: grants taunt for {rounds} starting next round. Foes that can reach you must target you.

entries.name: Lunge
entries.description: {name}: {power} power. Dashes up to {dash}. Gap-close: the dash is your move for the round.

entries.name: Bleeding Cut
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Bleed for {rounds}.

entries.name: Riposte
entries.description: {name}: -{mitigation} damage; grants riposte for {rounds}. Adjacent melee attackers you survive are countered for 50% of your attack power (once per attacker per round). Any stance change ends it; moving does not.

entries.name: Purify
entries.description: Purify: cleanses stun. Active or pending debuffs on a friendly unit within 3 tiles, or yourself. Buffs stay.

ranks.description: Purify II: cleanses stun, bleed. Active or pending debuffs on a friendly unit within 3 tiles, or yourself. Buffs stay.
Purify III: cleanses all. Active or pending debuffs on a friendly unit within 3 tiles, or yourself. Buffs stay.

entries.name: Backflip
entries.description: {name}: jump up to {jump} away from the nearest enemy (or a chosen one) to break melee contact. Your move for the round: it comes first, leaps over units but not walls, and a rooted unit can't.

entries.name: Sweep Kick
entries.description: {name}: {power} power. Sweep area, hits allies too. Aim at a diagonal neighbour to pick the quadrant. Bare hands or feet.

entries.name: Barbed Arrow
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Bleed for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Pounce
entries.description: {name}: {power} power. Dashes up to {dash}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. Gap-close: the dash is your move for the round.

entries.name: Smite
entries.description: {name}: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. Holy force from a distance.

entries.name: Deadeye
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Judgement
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Charge In
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Dashes up to {dash}. Gap-close: the dash is your move for the round.

entries.name: Lacerate
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Bleed for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Assassinate
entries.description: {name}: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Greater Mend
entries.description: Greater Mend: heals 10 + 1.8 x KNOW; cleanses stun. Within 3 tiles, or yourself.

ranks.description: Greater Mend II: heals 14 + 2.0 x KNOW; cleanses all. Within 3 tiles, or yourself.
Greater Mend III: heals 18 + 2.2 x KNOW; grants haste for 1 round starting next round; cleanses all. Within 3 tiles, or yourself.

entries.name: Renewal
entries.description: {name}: heals {heal}; grants haste for {rounds} starting next round. Within 3 tiles.

entries.name: Leap Back
entries.description: {name}: jump up to {jump} away from the nearest enemy (or a chosen one) to break melee contact. Your move for the round: it comes first, leaps over units but not walls, and a rooted unit can't.

entries.name: Arc Lance
entries.description: {name}: {power} power. Line area, hits allies too. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. Aim at an adjacent tile; hits the 3 tiles in a line.

entries.name: Intimidate
entries.description: {name}: no damage, {potency} to Weaken (-{magnitude} outgoing power) for {rounds}. Roar at a foe.

entries.name: Cyclone Kick
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds} on every enemy hit. Sweep area, hits allies too. Bare hands or feet.

entries.name: Inferno
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Bleed for {rounds} on every enemy hit. Burst area, hits allies too. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Glacial Burst
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Root for {rounds} on every enemy hit. Burst area, hits allies too. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Shield Wall
entries.description: {name}: -{mitigation} damage; grants taunt for {rounds} and {extra}. Foes that can reach you must target you, starting next round.

entries.name: Crippling Shot
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Slow for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Rend Armor
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Expose (-{magnitude}) for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Envenom
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Poison ({magnitude} per round, stacks) for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Aegis
entries.description: {name}: grants Fortify (+{magnitude}) for {rounds} starting next round.

entries.name: Rejuvenate
entries.description: {name}: grants Regen ({magnitude} per round) for {rounds} starting next round.

entries.name: Feint
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {flow}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Crushing Blow
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {disrupt}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Opportunist
entries.description: {name}: {power} power, {exploit}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entries.name: Active Guard
entries.description: Guard, Standard: raise a guard, -{mitigation} damage.

entries.name: Flank Cut
entries.description: Maneuver, Snap: {name}: {power} power, {stagger} stagger. Dashes up to {range} {position}, then hits.

entries.name: Brace and Counter
entries.description: Guard, Standard: -{mitigation} damage and grants riposte for {rounds}.

entries.name: Fade
entries.description: Guard, Snap: -{mitigation} damage and grants stealth for {rounds}.

entries.name: Field Dressing
entries.description: Support, Standard: {name}: heals {heal}. A friendly unit or yourself.

entries.name: Hamstring Cut
entries.description: Maneuver, Snap: {name}: {power} power, {stagger} stagger. Dashes up to {range} {position}; {exploit}.

entries.name: Slip Strike
entries.description: Maneuver, Standard: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Slow for {rounds}. Dashes up to {range} {position}.

entries.name: Snap Jab
entries.description: Assault, Snap: a quick jab that staggers ({stagger}).

entries.name: Thrust
entries.description: Assault, Standard: a straight thrust, {stagger} stagger.

entries.name: Heavy Cleave
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: a slow cleave that staggers hard ({stagger}).

entries.name: Shoulder Check
entries.description: Assault, Snap: a cheap shove ({stagger} stagger).

entries.name: Jaw-Breaker Drill
entries.description: Assault, Snap: a sure break on any stagger ({stagger}).

entries.name: Marrow Spike
entries.description: Assault, Snap: a spike that pierces armour.

entries.name: Hook Thrust
entries.description: Assault, Standard: a hooked thrust from reach, {stagger} stagger.

entries.name: Snap Shot
entries.description: Assault, Snap: a quick shot, {stagger} stagger.

entries.name: Aimed Shot
entries.description: Assault, Standard: a steady shot, {stagger} stagger.

entries.name: Overhead Smash
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: a windup smash, {stagger} stagger.

entries.name: Crushing Judgment
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: an unbreakable crushing blow, {stagger} stagger.

entries.name: Pommel Strike
entries.description: Assault, Snap: a pommel jab, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; timed into a windup it breaks the strike.

entries.name: Intercepting Hook
entries.description: Guard, Standard: -{mitigation} damage; the first melee hit on a friend within 1 tile lands on you whole, and the attacker is hooked 1 tile toward you.

entries.name: Billhook Sunder
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: Notched Billhook Sunder, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; exposes the target for {rounds} rounds.

entries.name: Ward Bulwark
entries.description: Guard, Heavy: Seventh Ward Bulwark, -{mitigation} damage; taunts enemies and fortifies you for 2 rounds.

entries.name: Hamstring Sever
entries.description: Maneuver, Snap: dash up to {dash} tiles and cut the leg, {power} power; slows the target; hits harder on a flanked foe.

entries.name: Ash-Cloud Fade
entries.description: Guard, Snap: -{mitigation} damage; grants stealth for {rounds} rounds and leaves Soot Smoke on the 3x3 around you.

entries.name: Throat-Carver
entries.description: Assault, Standard: Throat-Carver's Art, {power} power; strikes harder at a staggered, pinned or nearly dead foe.

entries.name: Retribution
entries.description: Maneuver, Standard: Orlov's Retribution, {power} power; dash {dash} tiles after the strike; harder on a staggered or pinned foe.

entries.name: Cauterize
entries.description: Support, Snap: Brimstone Cauterize, heals {heal} and cleanses bleed, poison and burn. A friendly unit or yourself.

entries.name: Tourniquet
entries.description: Support, Standard: Tourniquet and Tonic, heals {heal} and hastes the target; an ally broken this round holds a guard for the rest of it.

entries.name: Bile Coat
entries.description: Support, Snap: spends a Bile Phial pip to coat an ally's weapon, empowering them for a round.

entries.name: Resilience Ward
entries.description: Support, Heavy: one ally or yourself cannot be broken for a round and is fortified.

entries.name: Barbed Quarrel
entries.description: Assault, Standard: Poacher's Barbed Quarrel, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; bleeds the target.

entries.name: Tripwire Snare
entries.description: Assault, Snap: wire a tile 1-3 away; the first foe to cross takes damage, is rooted and stops.

entries.name: Winch Sunder
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: Heavy Winch Sunder, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; breaks a windup outright, exposes and knocks the target back 2 tiles.

entries.name: Shackle Slam
entries.description: Assault, Snap: Shackle-Pummel Slam, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; shoves the foe 1 tile and breaks it against a wall or a unit.

entries.name: Slag Slam
entries.description: Assault, Standard: Slag Slam and Throw, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; throws the foe 2 tiles into whatever stands behind it.

entries.name: Foundry Shatter
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: a sweeping blow, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; may stun.

entries.name: Phosphorus Pot
entries.description: Assault, Standard: a burst of phosphorus, {power} power; burns, and Pitch Fire stays on the ground for 2 rounds.

entries.name: Flash-Bomb
entries.description: Assault, Snap: Magnesium Flash-Bomb, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; may stagger everything in the burst.

entries.name: Choke-Gas
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: Suffocating Choke-Gas, {power} power; poisons, and the gas lingers 2 rounds.

entries.name: Heavy Thrust
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: Footman's Heavy Bill Thrust, {power} power, {stagger} stagger.

entries.name: Billhook Hook
entries.description: Assault, Standard: {power} power, {stagger} stagger; pulls a target that moved this round and cancels its later walks.

entries.name: Aimed Bolt
entries.description: Assault, Standard: {power} power, {stagger} stagger; exposes the target.

entries.name: Buckler Jab
entries.description: Assault, Snap: a buckler jab, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; shoves the target back 1 tile.

entries.name: Judgment
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: Crushing Judgment, a sweep of {power} power, {stagger} stagger that cannot be broken; may stun.

entries.name: Shackle Drag
entries.description: Assault, Standard: Iron Shackle Drag, {power} power; roots the target and drags it 2 tiles toward the Bailiff.

entries.name: Scourge Lash
entries.description: Assault, Snap: a lash, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; bleeds the target.

entries.name: Martyr's Rush
entries.description: Maneuver, Snap: dash up to {dash} tiles and strike, {power} power; costs 10 HP.

entries.name: Nozzle Sweep
entries.description: Assault, Standard: Pyre-Nozzle Sweep, {power} power; burns, and Phosphorus Fire stays on the ground for 2 rounds.

entries.name: Heretic's Brand
entries.description: Assault, Snap: Brand of the Heretic, {power} power; exposes the target and ends its guard.

entries.name: Grease Pot
entries.description: Assault, Standard: Scalding Grease Pot, {power} power; slows, and Scalding Grease stays on the ground for 2 rounds.

entries.name: Knife Flurry
entries.description: Maneuver, Snap: Boning Knife Flurry, dash up to {dash} tiles, {power} power; bleeds; hits harder on a flanked foe.

entries.name: Throat-Clamp
entries.description: Maneuver, Snap: Throat-Clamp Pounce, dash up to {dash} tiles, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; roots the target.

entries.name: Burrow Ambush
entries.description: Maneuver, Snap: dash up to {dash} tiles, {power} power; may stagger.

entries.name: Caustic Vomit
entries.description: Assault, Standard: {power} power; poisons the target.

entries.name: Bone-Club Slam
entries.description: Assault, Standard: {power} power, {stagger} stagger.

entries.name: Gilded Sunder
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: Gilded Billhook Sunder, a sweep of {power} power, {stagger} stagger; exposes, and pushes 1 tile.

entries.name: Execution Wall
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: Seventh Ward Execution Wall, a line of {power} power, {stagger} stagger; roots.

entries.name: Traitor's Parry
entries.description: Guard, Snap: -{mitigation} damage; grants riposte for {rounds} round.

entries.name: Vivisection
entries.description: Assault, Standard: Sanctified Vivisection, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; pierces armour and bleeds.

entries.name: Inquisitor's Parry
entries.description: Guard, Snap: -{mitigation} damage; grants riposte for {rounds} round.

entries.name: Transfusion Pulse
entries.description: Assault, Snap: Sacrificial Transfusion Pulse, a burst of {power} power, {stagger} stagger.

entries.name: Hammer Strike
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: Pneumatic Hammer Strike, a sweep of {power} power, {stagger} stagger; knocks adjacent units down (Staggered).

entries.name: Shovel Jab
entries.description: Assault, Snap: Coal Shovel Jab, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; burns.

entries.name: Pulverizer
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: Bone-Mill Pulverizer, a burst of {power} power, {stagger} stagger that cannot be broken.

entries.name: Lard Spray
entries.description: Assault, Standard: Pressurized Lard Spray, a burst of {power} power, {stagger} stagger; burns.

entries.name: Hook Drag
entries.description: Assault, Standard: Flensing Hook Drag, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; exposes the target.

entries.name: Cataclysm
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: Scalding Flensing Cataclysm, a burst of {power} power, {stagger} stagger; bleeds and pulls 1 tile.

entries.name: Spine Volley
entries.description: Assault, Standard: Ossified Spine Volley, a burst of {power} power, {stagger} stagger; bleeds, allies too.

entries.name: Tendril Flail
entries.description: Assault, Standard: Marrow Tendril Flail, a sweep of {power} power, {stagger} stagger.

entries.name: Bone Bloom
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: Catastrophic Ossification Bloom, a burst of {power} power, {stagger} stagger that cannot be broken; roots.

entries.name: Decapitation
entries.description: Assault, Heavy: Sanctified Decapitation, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; cannot be broken and ignores guard.

entries.name: Censure
entries.description: Assault, Standard: the Prelate's Censure, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; weakens the target.
